text: Electroshield Samara, an electrical equipment plant in Samara, is part of Akron Holding, a Tolyatti-based industrial holding.
short: Electroshield Samara is one of Akron Holding's enterprises.

source.name: Akron Holding: О компании (About the company)
source.note: English: 'The plants Electroshield Samara, Russky Transformator and Foskhim are part of Akron Holding.' The holding's enterprise directory lists Электрощит Самара under its electrotechnical division.
source.quote: В состав Акрон Холдинга входят заводы Электрощит Самара, Русский трансформатор, Фосфохим.
